_about: Runtime settings for the public UserSim MCP server (/mcp). Anyone can change them: edit this file and merge the PR to main. The running server re-reads this file from main on GitHub every refresh_s seconds (default 300), so no redeploy and no env vars are needed. Only 'value' is read; 'about' explains cost/risk. Env vars named MVP_MCP_<KEY in upper case> override a value on one server if set (optional). See docs/mcp/CONFIG.md.

refresh_s.about: How often (seconds) the server re-reads this file from main. Minimum 30.

allow_anonymous.about: true = anyone with the URL can call /mcp without a token. false = only callers with a bearer token (kill switch).

max_sessions.about: Browser sessions open at once across the whole server, all callers. Higher = more Browserbase cost and RAM.

max_per_client.about: Browser sessions open at once per client IP for callers that send a bearer token (a study client runs cells in parallel).

anon_max_concurrent_sessions_per_ip.about: Browser sessions open at once per client IP for callers without a token.

max_steps.about: Browser actions (usersim_act, open_verification_link, solve_captcha) allowed per session before usersim_finish is required. Higher = longer runs and more Browserbase + model cost (each step is charged est_usd_per_step against anonymous budgets).

budget_s.about: Wall-clock seconds per browser session (15 minutes). Higher = longer Browserbase sessions and higher spend.

idle_s.about: Seconds without a tool call before the server closes an idle browser session (5 minutes).

max_cells.about: Maximum runs (persona x task x site) in one study for any caller. 108 = full e2e (6 x 6 x 3). Lower only for smoke tests.

wait_max_s.about: Upper bound (seconds) on usersim_wait_for_verification_code/link and usersim_wait_for_sms_code per call. Agents should call again; higher = longer tool calls and more server wait time.

paid_captcha.about: Master switch for the paid CapSolver path on this server. When true, approved hosts may buy tokens (metered in captcha_spend.py; typically ~$0.002-0.01 per solve). Callers without a token still need anon_allow_paid_captcha true. Requires MVP_CAPTCHA_API_KEY in server env (not in this file).

study_shared_accounts.about: One signup per site per study: the first cell to call usersim_signup_identity creates the account, later cells of the same study on the same site get that account to log in with (as with same_account_as). A cell whose owner ended without a verified signup takes over. false = every cell signs up on its own (hundreds of signups against one product, and sites that treat Gmail dot-variants as one address answer with errors).

paid_captcha_max_tries.about: Paid CapSolver tokens one session may buy before an act-triggered presolve stops (was a fixed 2: the Oct 18 Smartsheet study had 13 of 24 stuck cells with no paid try and 3 that used both). Each token is about $0.001-0.003.

paid_captcha_max_solves.about: Hard cap of CapSolver createTask calls per session (the ledger's per-attempt cap, was a fixed 3). The per-site ($1.50) and total ($15) USD caps in captcha_spend.py still apply.

captcha_max_calls_per_page.about: How many times usersim_solve_captcha may run on one URL before it refuses and tells the agent to finish as blocked (was a fixed 3).

captcha_stuck_steps.about: Consecutive steps with a reCAPTCHA image challenge still open before the observation tells the agent to call usersim_finish with outcome 'blocked'; at twice this many, usersim_act refuses further actions on that page. 0 turns the guard off.

probe_sites.about: When true, usersim_start_session refuses product URLs whose TLS certificate is invalid or host does not resolve. false skips the check (faster starts; may waste a browser on dead hosts).

bb_proxies.about: When true, Browserbase sessions use residential proxies (higher success on signup flows; higher Browserbase cost). false uses cheaper datacenter routing.

anon_daily_usd_per_ip.about: Estimated spend allowed per client IP per day (America/Los_Angeles day) for callers without a token. Estimated with the est_usd_* rates below; real cost is not metered per call. 15 ≈ one 108-cell study per IP per day (docs/E2E_TEST.md needs 108 cells per study; a typical study ≈ 13.5 units).

anon_daily_usd_global.about: Estimated spend allowed per day across ALL callers without a token, together.

est_usd_per_session.about: Budget units charged when a browser session starts. Calibrated Oct 18 from the four 108-cell studies of Oct 13: server-side Vertex (judge + planner) was about $0.72 for ~394 cells (≈ $0.002/cell); the rest of this value covers Browserbase time. The driver model is the caller's, not ours.

est_usd_per_step.about: Budget units charged per browser step (usersim_act, usersim_open_verification_link, usersim_solve_captcha). Oct 13 full studies averaged ~15 steps per cell, so a typical cell = 0.05 + 15 x 0.005 ≈ 0.125 and a 108-cell study ≈ 13.5.

est_usd_per_prediction.about: Budget units charged per agent-mode prediction that returns results (usersim_predict_experience). Covers live review scrapes of the product and its rivals (Apify, about $0.5 per 100 reviews) and one model call. An assumption, not a measured cost.

anon_max_cells_per_study.about: Most persona x task x site runs one study may have, for callers without a token.

anon_allow_sms.about: Let callers without a token use usersim_signup_phone / usersim_wait_for_sms_code. The number is the owner's real phone, so it is made safe instead of blocked: one session holds the number at a time (sms_lease_s), a session only gets texts that arrived after its own lease started, and texts matching sms_sender_denylist are never returned to anyone.

sms_lease_s.about: Seconds one session holds the phone number after usersim_signup_phone (or until that session closes). Another session asking meanwhile gets 'number busy, retry in N s'. Applies to every caller, token or not.

anon_daily_sms_leases_per_ip.about: SMS-number leases per client IP per day (America/Los_Angeles) for callers without a token.

sms_sender_denylist.about: Texts whose sender (ntfy title) or body contains any of these words (case-insensitive, whole word) are never returned by usersim_wait_for_sms_code, to any caller. Protects the owner's personal codes: Apple ID ('Your Apple Account Code is ...'), banks, Google and other 2FA. Add a word with a PR.

anon_allow_paid_captcha.about: When paid_captcha is true: let callers WITHOUT a bearer token trigger CapSolver (~$0.002-0.01 per solve, metered). false = only token callers may use paid solving. Free Browserbase/audio/v3 refresh paths are unaffected.

anon_allow_shared_aliases.about: Let callers without a token use no_plus (Gmail dot-variant) or plain shared signup addresses. Those addresses can repeat across sessions, so another anonymous caller could read the same inbox and steal verification codes. false = anonymous callers only get unique usersim.signups+<tag>@gmail.com aliases (safe default).
